title: Burke Ratio Catalog: 10 Dyadic Ratios + Higher-Order Combinations
purpose: Standalone queryable catalog subsidiary to Manual Section B. Each ratio entry carries directionality, philosophic-school deployment, paradigm literary examples, candidate game-user-motive deployment, and candidate Calleja-PIM-dimension-pair cross-link.
primary_source: GM-01 Container and Thing Contained (Burke develops the dyadic-ratio apparatus in extenso); cross-referenced with GM-04/05/06/07 (philosophic-school deployments) and GM-08/10/12 (applied dramatism).
content_filter_compliance: All Burke prose paraphrased; no ≥25-word verbatim.

ratios.name: scene-act
ratios.operational_gloss_le80: Quality of scene implies (contains, calls forth) correspondingly qualified act; convertibly, act demands or constructs a scene of corresponding quality. Reversible; deterministic or hortatory.
ratios.directionality: Reversible. Forward: scene calls forth act. Reverse: act constructs scene (Lavinia's command, GM-01 pp.5-6).

philosophic_school_deployment.primary: Materialism (Scene-featuring schools deploy scene-act deterministically — Marxist 'objective situation', Darwinian environmental determinism)
philosophic_school_deployment.secondary: Idealism (Hegelian Reason-as-Grundprinzip), Realism (cosmic-scene → cosmic-act in Aristotelian-Aquinas frame)

paradigm_literary_examples: Ibsen *Enemy of the People* — bourgeois sitting-room, editorial office, disordered study (GM-01 pp.3-5)
O'Neill *Mourning Becomes Electra* (Lavinia nails shutters; GM-01 pp.5-6)
Horatio's Hamlet warning — sea-cliff scene (GM-01 p.6)
Coleridge Pantisocracy (GM-01 p.14)
ratios.candidate_game_user_motive_deployment: How does the game-world's affordance-structure constrain or enable the session-act? Deterministic ('design made me do it') vs hortatory ('design demands I act'). Lavinia-reversal cases: where does the act produce a scene that produces further acts (e.g., player-built base in survival game becomes the scene of subsequent play)?
ratios.candidate_calleja_pim_pair: SPATIAL ↔ LUDIC primary; with KINESTHETIC modulation under heavy-navigation cases
ratios.pim_pair_rationale: Scene = virtual environment / place-as-inhabited (Spatial); act = choice + repercussion within the affordance of the scene (Ludic). Precisely the question of how gameworld affordances call forth gameplay-acts.
ratios.provenance: burke-direct (Burke develops at length GM-01 pp.3-7 + Ubiquity sections pp.11-15)

ratios.name: scene-agent
ratios.operational_gloss_le80: Synecdochic correspondence: quality of place implies corresponding quality of inhabitant. Contents of a divine container share in its divinity. Positional in strong sense (scene contains agent).
ratios.directionality: Reversible. Forward: scene-quality implies agent-quality (divine scene → divine child, Wordsworth sonnet). Reverse: body-as-scenic (theologians treat body as dwelling-place of soul, GM-01 p.10).

philosophic_school_deployment.primary: Idealism (whole 19th-century *Einklang zwischen Innen- und Aussenwelt* formation; 'climates of opinion' Becker)
philosophic_school_deployment.secondary: Materialism (Darwinian environment-shaping-organism); Realism (Aristotelian appropriate-scene-to-agent via entelechy)

paradigm_literary_examples: Carlyle *Heroes and Hero-Worship* on Arabs and Arabian country (GM-01 pp.7-8)
Wordsworth 'It is a beauteous evening' sonnet (GM-01 p.8)
Swift Laputans on the floating island (GM-01 p.9)
Seurat pointillism — figures dissolving into background (GM-01 p.8)
Moore appropriate-scene-to-agent: basilisk lives in basilica (GM-12)
ratios.candidate_game_user_motive_deployment: How does the gameworld qualify the avatar inhabiting it? Spatial-internalization phenomenology: the player comes to inhabit the place. Test case: how does WoW's Azeroth socialize different agent-types (warrior in Mulgore vs mage in Dalaran)? Body-as-scenic reverse case: avatar as scenic ground for the player.
ratios.candidate_calleja_pim_pair: SPATIAL ↔ KINESTHETIC primary; with SHARED modulation in multi-agent environments
ratios.pim_pair_rationale: Burkean synecdoche between place and inhabitant maps onto Calleja's spatial-internalization (player comes to inhabit the place); kinesthetic carries the embodied-in-scene dimension.

ratios.name: scene-agency
ratios.operational_gloss_le80: Scene shapes which agencies are available, sustainable, or efficacious; conversely, the introduction of new agencies transforms the scene that contains them.
ratios.directionality: Reversible. Forward: scene affords/constrains agency. Reverse: agencies-in-accumulation become scenic (Biddle pattern — Burke's reverse-direction signature case).

philosophic_school_deployment.primary: Pragmatism (agencies become scenic — instrument-as-ancestor), with Materialism (terrain-as-affordance-set)

paradigm_literary_examples: Burke on Francis Biddle: agencies of communication (railroad, telegraph, telephone, automobile, movie, airplane, radio) by accumulation become scenic and motivate political acts (GM-01 p.18) — the chapter's clearest direct case
ratios.candidate_game_user_motive_deployment: Which agencies have become scenic by accumulation? VR-hardware, voice-chat, streaming-overlays, Discord, third-party trackers (DPS-meters, builds-databases) all began as agencies but in accumulation now constitute the operative scene of competitive play. Test: when did 'using Discord' shift from agency to scenic-baseline?
ratios.candidate_calleja_pim_pair: SPATIAL ↔ KINESTHETIC (agency = control surface) OR SPATIAL ↔ LUDIC (agency = available game-systems)
ratios.pim_pair_rationale: The gameworld affords specific control-schemes and game-systems; new technological agencies become scenic in the way new platforms transform game-worlds (Biddle pattern applied to VR / cloud / cross-play).
ratios.provenance: burke-direct (Biddle case at p.18 is Burke's primary instance)

ratios.name: scene-purpose
ratios.operational_gloss_le80: Scene shapes which purposes are conceivable, pursuable, or fulfillable within it; conversely, a purpose may project or demand a scene proportioned to it (mystical exegesis).
ratios.directionality: Likely reversible. Burke does not extensively develop in GM-01; announces (p.15) examination at GM-07. In mysticism the reverse direction dominates: cosmic Purpose projects providential Scene.

philosophic_school_deployment.primary: Mysticism (Purpose-featuring projects cosmic-scenes proportioned to mystical Purpose — Plotinus, Bonaventura)
philosophic_school_deployment.secondary: Idealism (Hegelian Reason-as-Grundprinzip as scene-purpose move, GM-01 p.12)

paradigm_literary_examples: Hegelian Reason as Grundprinzip — Reason as supra-scenic ultimate ground oriented toward purpose-of-history (GM-01 p.12)
Heretical-Christian Judas case: cosmic Scene of providence reframes betrayal toward divine Purpose (GM-00 p.xxi)
Mystical sacred geographies and eschatological horizons (GM-07 reasoned extension)
ratios.candidate_game_user_motive_deployment: What ends does this game-world make conceivable that others would not? Narrative-scene-design dictates purpose-structure (rails-narrative imposes narrow purpose-set; emergent-design affords broad purpose-set). Test: how does Skyrim's open-world Scene afford purposes that linear FPS scenes preclude?
ratios.candidate_calleja_pim_pair: SPATIAL ↔ NARRATIVE primary; with LUDIC modulation
ratios.pim_pair_rationale: The gameworld affords particular purpose-structures (quest-givers, goal-objects, narrative arcs); narrative-purpose tends to be scene-mediated.

ratios.name: act-agent
ratios.operational_gloss_le80: Agent authors acts; acts make or remake the agent. NOT strict containment — agent does not contain the act, though results pre-exist virtually within him. Temporal/sequential rather than synecdochic.
ratios.directionality: Temporal-sequential. Forward: agent's nature authors acts. Reverse: acts make or remake agent (offices, vestments, situations shape character — GM-01 p.16).

philosophic_school_deployment.primary: Idealism (agent-character authoring acts; Marxism's reverse — class-act remaking class-agent)
philosophic_school_deployment.secondary: Realism (agent's entelechy authoring proper acts of its kind)

paradigm_literary_examples: 'Sobering influence of the Presidency on any man' — office shapes occupant (GM-01 p.16)
Priestly vestments and judicial robes transform wearer (GM-01 p.16)
Russian wartime resistance attributed to Russian patriotism rather than socialism — act-agent deflects scene-act (GM-01 pp.16-17)
Democracy as residing in 'a democratic people' who perform democratic acts (GM-01 p.17)
ratios.candidate_game_user_motive_deployment: How does what-is-being-done modify who-is-doing-it? Alterbiography emergence (Calleja Ch. 7): what acts have remade this player-agent? The Burkean point that 'acts can make him or remake him' is precisely the alterbiography move. Test: how does a player's 1000-hour main-character history shape their current playstyle?
ratios.candidate_calleja_pim_pair: LUDIC ↔ SHARED primary; with KINESTHETIC modulation
ratios.pim_pair_rationale: Act = choice-with-repercussion; agent = the player shaped by the choices made. Burke's 'acts make him or remake him' is alterbiography-emergence.

ratios.name: act-agency
ratios.operational_gloss_le80: Act overlaps with agency when method (met-hodos) becomes means-of-doing rather than act-of-being. Way-words (hodos, tao, yoga, dike) originally act-words drift toward agency under instrumentalist reading.
ratios.directionality: Reversible. Forward: act's character constrains fit agencies. Reverse: agency re-characterizes the act it instantiates (scientific method turns inquiry into procedure).

philosophic_school_deployment.primary: Pragmatism (act-agency dominance — James cash-value; Dewey instrumentalism; Mead philosophy-of-the-act)

paradigm_literary_examples: Burke's way-words analysis: scientific method (met-hodos) thought of as means of doing rather than way of life (GM-01 p.15)
Writing as act overlapping with agency of language (reasoned extension)
Voting as act overlapping with agency of the ballot (reasoned extension)
ratios.candidate_game_user_motive_deployment: Where does act-of-play merge with agency of input (kinesthetic transparency)? The Bridgman-operationalist limit-case: meaning equated with operations. Test: in a FGC player's frame-perfect inputs, is the act ('execute the combo') distinguishable from the agency ('press these inputs')?
ratios.pim_pair_rationale: The act (choice) overlaps with the agency (control input) precisely on Burke's way-words point — means-of-doing and act-of-being interpenetrate.

ratios.name: act-purpose
ratios.operational_gloss_le80: Act is consummated only insofar as it realizes the purpose for which it is done; purpose is articulate only insofar as it admits expression in concrete act. Reciprocal teleological closure.
ratios.directionality: Reversible in principle. Burke does not extensively develop in GM-01.

philosophic_school_deployment.primary: Mysticism (teleological act; Christ 'I am the way')
philosophic_school_deployment.secondary: Realism (Aristotelian act ordered toward its proper telos)

paradigm_literary_examples: Hero-file: 'break his bonds (act) in order to escape (purpose)' (GM-00 p.xx)
Aeschylean Erinyes→Eumenides as act-purpose total transformation (GM-01 p.20)
Keats Ode oracular Beauty-is-truth identity as act-purpose (GM-10 stanza V)
ratios.candidate_game_user_motive_deployment: How does the act realize / transform its purpose? Emergent-story engine: the act-purpose ratio generates alterbiography narrative arc. Test: how does the act of completing a raid realize (or fail) the purpose of mastery-display?
ratios.pim_pair_rationale: Choice-with-repercussion (Ludic) tends toward narrative articulation of purpose; the act-purpose ratio is the engine of emergent story.

ratios.name: agent-agency
ratios.operational_gloss_le80: Agent's character implies fit agencies; agencies habitually employed help constitute agent's character. Symbolic-of-agency mother-locus (GM-07).
ratios.directionality: Reversible. Forward: agent-character implies fit agency. Reverse: habituated agencies constitute character.
paradigm_literary_examples: Seurat pointillism — medium constitutes artist's identity (GM-01 p.8)
Voter as politician's agency (GM-00 p.xx)
Orator's preferred rhetorical agencies constitute orator's identity (reasoned extension)
ratios.candidate_game_user_motive_deployment: How do habituated control-schemes / play-styles constitute player-identity? Test: how does a 'main' character (main-class, main-build) function as Symbolic-of-agency mother-locus for the player? Signature build / signature playstyle as agency-constituting-identity.
ratios.candidate_calleja_pim_pair: SHARED ↔ KINESTHETIC primary; with LUDIC modulation
ratios.pim_pair_rationale: The agent (player) habituates to specific agencies (control schemes, play-styles); this habituation constitutes player-identity in the social field.

ratios.name: agent-purpose
ratios.operational_gloss_le80: Needs are a property of agents (GM-01 p.18); agent-purpose is the relation between an agent's needs/wants/aspirations and the purposes they generate.
ratios.directionality: Reversible. Forward: agent-character implies purposes. Reverse: purposes shape the agent who pursues them.
paradigm_literary_examples: Burke's Biddle analysis: 'needs are a property of agents; hence an act designed to produce a situation more responsive to our needs has its most direct locus of motivation under heading of agent' (GM-01 p.18) — direct instance
Dr. Stockmann's purpose to enroll twelve disciples rooted in his character (GM-01 p.5)
ratios.candidate_game_user_motive_deployment: What does this player want, given who this player is? Alterbiography-as-need-generator: the player's emergent history generates new wants. Test: in WoW, how does a long-term raider's identity generate the purpose to complete Cutting Edge achievements?
ratios.candidate_calleja_pim_pair: SHARED ↔ LUDIC primary; with NARRATIVE+AFFECTIVE modulation
ratios.pim_pair_rationale: The player-as-agent (Shared) generates Ludic purposes (goals) shaped by Narrative arc and Affective regulation/mastery needs.

ratios.name: agency-purpose
ratios.operational_gloss_le80: Agency drifts toward its own teleology under sustained use (pragmatism's philosophy of means); purpose conversely shapes which agencies are admissible as fit means. THE diagnostic ratio for distinguishing pragmatism (Agency-pole) from mysticism (Purpose-pole).
ratios.directionality: Reversible. Forward: agency drifts toward own teleology. Reverse: purpose dictates admissible agency-set.

philosophic_school_deployment.secondary: Mysticism (Purpose-pole — Huxley Mysticism of Means as critiqued limit-case)

paradigm_literary_examples: 'End justifies the means' (and denial) as agency-purpose ratio dispute (reasoned extension)
Bridgman: writing about purpose in eliminating concept of purpose (GM-07)
Aldous Huxley pacifism — Mysticism of Means (GM-07's critiqued limit-case)
Sacraments / prayer / ascetic practice shaped by soteriological purpose (reasoned extension)
ratios.candidate_game_user_motive_deployment: Where does means become end (speedrun / grind / metagame as purpose-drift)? Test: in a speedrunner's mastery-of-glitches, has the agency (frame-perfect exploit-execution) become the purpose, eclipsing the game-internal goal? Pragmatist or mystic stance toward the dyad?
ratios.pim_pair_rationale: The pragmatist pole privileges Kinesthetic+Ludic agency-as-end; the mystical pole privileges Narrative+Affective purpose-absorption. GM-07's culminating ratio maps onto Calleja's most acute internal tension.

higher_order_combinations.label: scene-act-agent triadic — Russian-resistance
higher_order_combinations.description: Russian wartime resistance read as scene-act (Soviet structure motivates) competing with act-agent (Russian patriotism motivates). Burke uses triadic deployment to expose rhetorical-deflection function of ratio-selection.
higher_order_combinations.dissertation_use: Analytic test for any motive-attribution: which competing ratios could account for the outcome? Whose interest is served by the chosen attribution?

higher_order_combinations.label: scene-act-agent triadic — Edenic paradigm
higher_order_combinations.description: Mutual ratification: agent acts in keeping with nature (act-agent) → changes scene (scene-act) → likens self to scene (scene-agent). Total ratification in one unending moment.
higher_order_combinations.dissertation_use: Diagnostic lens for fully-immersive sessions where all positional ratios align (the rare 'in-the-zone' totality).

higher_order_combinations.label: act-purpose-agent triadic — Aeschylus Erinyes→Eumenides
higher_order_combinations.description: Orestes' sufferings + Athena's intervention transform Furies from Erinyes (purpose: avenge evil) to Eumenides (purpose: reward good) — triadic motivational transformation.
higher_order_combinations.dissertation_use: Lens for permanent player-identity reversals (the 'I was once a griefer, now I'm a teacher' conversion arc).

higher_order_combinations.label: scene-agency-act-agent four-term cascade
higher_order_combinations.description: Agencies become scenic → scenic-agencies motivate acts → unsatisfied needs return motivation to agent. Burke's 'shift of ratios.'
higher_order_combinations.dissertation_use: Lens for technological transitions in game-culture (VR / streaming / mobile becoming scenic; new agencies motivate new acts; player-needs return motivation to player-agent).

directionality_summary.burke_note_book_page_19: Burke himself singles out scene-act and scene-agent as the only ratios 'fitting with complete comfort' in the container-and-thing-contained framework; act-agent 'tugs at its edges'; remainder require additional dialectical apparatus.

meta.provenance_note: All Calleja PIM mappings are anticipatory-projection (dissertation); Burke 1945 predates Calleja by 66 years.
